title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.1-rc.3
summary: Review fixes for the RC2 transfer experience, plus encrypted clipboard framing and cleanup regressions. Includes prior hardening and progress/cancel/pacing. Install the same RC on both PCs; real-PC validation remains required.
changes: Correct encrypted payload padding for clipboard text/images; share framing helpers with file transfers and test awkward byte lengths.
Stop new file transfers during controlled exit, cancel active copies, and wait for their cleanup. Transfer windows no longer veto application shutdown.
Preserve both files even when adding a duplicate number to a maximum-length filename. Validate incoming headers, reserved filenames, lengths, and clipboard allocation limits.
Detach incoming image data from its stream before queuing clipboard delivery. Decode only actual text characters and bound decompression rather than append unused buffer contents.
Recheck clipboard/file sharing when delivering queued data. Discard disabled inline clipboard payloads while still draining their packets to preserve the mouse/keyboard connection.
Dispose failed clipboard connections, bound connection attempts to 10 seconds and handshake writes to 30 seconds, and guarantee session cleanup on receive failures.
Keep speed selections synchronized between transfer windows on the same PC; disable completed-window controls, keep progress below 100% until success, and retain full error details in a tooltip.
testing: Exit MWB on both PCs, back up the EXE and preferences, then replace only the EXE. Confirm About says 1.0.1-rc.3 on both.
Transfer small, empty, and large disposable files both ways. While a large copy runs, move the remote mouse and type; compare Protect mouse with Faster if desired.
Cancel once from each PC. Then start another copy and choose MWB Exit while it runs. Confirm MWB exits and restarts normally; no incomplete file should be presented as a completed destination.
Send a second different file with the same name. Confirm the original survives and the new file gets a numbered name. Long filenames should also work.

Copy short Unicode text, formatted text, and screenshots in both directions. Confirm exact text and complete images. Toggle Share Clipboard off and confirm subsequent incoming clipboard content is not applied.
Disconnect Wi-Fi mid-copy; restore it and retry by sending the file again. Confirm the receiver reports interruption rather than completion.
Recheck settings persistence, reconnect, lock/unlock, and sleep/wake.
known_limitations: Fixed-rate pacing remains a configurable starting point, not adaptive Wi-Fi QoS or a guarantee of lag-free input.
No pause/resume, one-click retry, end-to-end checksum receipt, folders, transfer queue, or Explorer-window drop targeting yet.
Sender completion means bytes were written to the connection; only the receiver confirms its destination was committed.
Clipboard payloads above 256 MiB and decompressed text above 32 million UTF-16 characters are rejected; ordinary disk-file transfers have no such size cap.

Hard process termination or power loss can leave a .partial file. Controlled exit attempts cleanup and keeps the app open if normal cleanup needs more time. Broader IPC listener and protocol-authentication audit follow-ups remain.
